findings.summary: Existing approval and lifecycle controls do not establish an approved deployment matrix, host-verifiable consent, browser CSP/Trusted Types enforcement, or a uniform default policy across host-only execution, browser execution, and plugin installation.
findings.limitations: Static inspection did not include reverse-proxy deployment controls or a live browser/CSP probe; the VM timeout is documented as cooperative rather than a security boundary.

current_contract.host: Host-only dynamic packages can run immediately through the host path and the runner Config currently exposes vmTimeoutMs but no deployment policy.
current_contract.client: Browser evaluation uses new Function and dynamic style/module loading; the guard explicitly is not a security boundary.
current_contract.consent: Client packages have approval state, but direct panel activation and caller-supplied requests are not host-verifiable user gestures across all entry points.
current_contract.deployment: Plugin Manager accepts multiple arbitrary source forms and installed bundles are enabled by default; the Web composition mounts dynamic runner surfaces by default.
current_contract.security: No repository-owned CSP, nonce, Trusted Types, or strict public-entry negative test was found in the inspected surfaces.

decision.required: Approve the supported deployment, CSP, consent, source, and default-enable policy before implementation.
must_define: supported deployments and whether programmatic/headless/SDK/ACP callers are allowed
whether dynamic code is opt-in and whether host-only execution may run without consent
consent granularity and binding to session/page/tab/package/version
CSP stance: redesign, explicit unsafe-eval/inline policy, or block browser halves
publisher/signature/registry allowlisting versus explicit arbitrary-source approval
default enablement for runners and installed bundles

lead_validation.procedure: Inspect the cited runner, evaluator, module, plugin, composition, and test sources with line-numbered rg output after the independent scout returned; no files or generated artifacts were changed.
lead_validation.limitations: No policy or negative test was added because the backlog action explicitly requires approval of deployment, CSP, consent, and default behavior first.
